notes: Body resolves event participants and copies the formatted stack string into caller x1 using sign-extended 32-bit capacity. Caller passes an index into 0x68-byte event rows and a 0x100-byte buffer. Candidate prototype is consistent with these register roles.
Body selects globals using arg2 bit zero and performs indexed status work. Caller invokes both sides with the same other arguments. Candidate subsystem remains unresolved.

The body caches x1, resolves the player record, and copies selected record blocks. At +0x110 ST64 stores x1 directly in incoming x0, and LD64 reloads it and dereferences its first pointer. The caller supplies the saved source handle.

Mode and status checks gate a global predicate with no live incoming arguments. The lookup writes its row address into an out slot using base plus unsigned byte index times 0xe6. The predicate loads one byte at row+4 and ANDs with 0x0e before returning true. Caller tests bit zero. Bool prototype supported.

Signed 32-bit input and its negated magnitude feed base-1000 grouping. The negative path prepends a sign, and full-width x2 is saved and later reused as output copy and clear length. Prototype consistent with caller arguments.

The wrapper pointee feeds the requested integer attribute. Category checks, subject byte state, normalization and clamped remapping affect its multiplier. Final float converts to signed 32-bit and caller stores w0 for two attribute IDs. Candidate prototype supported.

The body extracts name components, builds style-dependent strings, and uses incoming float in the measured-width shortening path. Caller passes style, player handle, stack output and capacity separately from the float.

The routine builds game-event batting lines and selected highlight text. Incoming x8 is the destination, observed in the caller reading its first bytes after return. Final bounded copy and terminator are at 14551-14557.

Checks flags, status, source and record out lookup. Adds unsigned record halfword, sign-extended low halfword of argument, and truncated attribute ID five from a status-selected subobject. Caller compares the integer result.

Uses owner+0x68 as the nested attribute provider, classifies ID into a numeric style and forwards the float and output destination to the formatter. Full-width capacity takes an unsigned minimum-two check. Caller supplies a 32-byte string buffer. Candidate prototype supported.
